subject: Vendor invoice submission: portal vs inbox and sample template
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: accounts@bluesky-logistics.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor setup / invoice submission question

Hi Jane / BlueSky AP team,

Thanks for starting the onboarding packet last week. Two quick questions so we can wire up PO & invoice matching correctly on our side:  

1) Preferred invoice submission channel: do you plan to submit invoices via your portal (we can integrate the SFTP/API export) or by emailing invoices to accounts@redwood-payables.com? Our preferred flow is portal because it gives automated PO matching and better visibility, but we can accept email for early invoices while you finish integration.

2) Invoice template: attached is our recommended CSV template (Redwood_Invoice_Template_v2.csv). Can you confirm whether BlueSky’s system can export to a CSV with the following columns: VendorName, VendorTaxID, PO#, Invoice#, InvoiceDate(YYYY-MM-DD), LineDescription, Qty, UnitPrice, LineTotal, TaxTotal, InvoiceTotal? If not, tell us which fields you can provide and we’ll map.

If you prefer a short call to walk through the portal vs inbox tradeoffs, I can set aside 30 minutes this week.

Thanks — feel free to loop in your AP lead.

Best,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0199
attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_BlueSky.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_Template_v2.csv

From: accounts@bluesky-logistics.com <accounts@bluesky-logistics.com>

Cc: jane.dawson@acme-payments.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / invoice submission question

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — received. Quick answers from our AP team:  

- We currently submit invoices by email to our customers (PDF) and can attach a CSV export but it's not part of our regular send flow.
- We can include PO# in the subject line or the PDF body, but our export columns differ (we include an item SKU and a combined Address field instead of separate City/State/Zip).

Would submitting invoices to accounts@redwood-payables.com (PDF + single-line PO in subject) work for the first 2 months while we build an automated CSV export? If you need the CSV columns as-is, we can provide a sample file.

Best,
Rachael Park
Accounts Payable Manager
BlueSky Logistics
attachments: BlueSky_invoice_sample.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / invoice submission question

Hi Rachael — thanks for the quick reply and the sample. A few clarifications from the Redwood side:  

- Short term: yes, email (PDF) to accounts@redwood-payables.com is fine for the first 60 days. Please put the PO# in the subject as PO: <number> and include the invoice number in the PDF header. That lets our automated ingestion pick up the key IDs.

- Long term: portal (CSV/API) is strongly preferred. We have an automated PO reconciliation job that requires the discrete columns listed in the template (PO#, LineDescription, Qty, UnitPrice, LineTotal). If BlueSky's export currently has SKU instead of LineDescription we can map SKU->LineDescription for now; please send a sample CSV and we'll create the mapping rule.

- Taxes: include TaxTotal and indicate whether it is included in LineTotal or added as a separate line.

If you can drop the sample CSV into the Drive folder linked below, we’ll draft a mapping and send it back for sign-off.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Engineering Ops (Invoice Integration) | Redwood Inference

Hi Rachael — really helpful, thank you. Summary and next steps from Redwood:  

1) Short term (0–60 days): Submit invoices via email to accounts@redwood-payables.com. Put the PO in the subject line as "PO: <number>". For PO-less invoices under $250 mark subject "NO-PO: <brief-desc>" and copy marissa_cole@redwood.com for manual routing.

2) Long term (60+ days): We will onboard BlueSky to our vendor portal and enable CSV export ingestion. Action items for BlueSky: provide a sample CSV with both SKU and ItemDesc if possible (we can map SKU->ItemDesc but having both reduces ambiguity). Please confirm whether Tax is per-line or summary-level.

3) Attached is our canonical CSV template (Redwood_Invoice_Template_v2.csv) and the Vendor Onboarding Form you returned (Vendor_Onboarding_Form_BlueSky.pdf) — thanks for completing it. We'll have engineering (Dev) create a mapping rule for your export and follow up with a test file.

4) Timeline: mapping draft by 2026-02-24, test ingestion week of 2026-03-01, portal cutover mid-March if testing is successful.

If anything changes on your side, reply to this thread. Otherwise, we’ll send the mapping doc by Wednesday.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
